name: Kahite Pub & Grill
lede: At a golf course in the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains, a new covered patio doubles the pub’s room for events. Nine Tungsten Electric heaters under its low ceiling, with curtains against the wind, keep it open all year.
data: Covered golf-club patio for about 100 guests

hero.caption: Tungsten Smart-Heat® Electric – a product photograph, not this project. The case study carries no photographs of the patio.

beats: Kahite Golf Course covers 200 acres in the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains, with views over Tellico Lake. A covered patio for about 100 people was added to the Pub & Grill to extend its entertainment space.
Events often outgrew the pub. The patio had to be usable all year – through regular winds and winter lows the case study puts at 5 °C – under a relatively low ceiling.
With technical help from Bromic’s sales team, the club installed nine Tungsten Electric 6000 W heaters, each covering up to 15 m², and added curtains to keep the heat in.
